average shuttle run improvement or decline per location, endline minus baseline
attempts.response:
```sql
WITH location_improvements AS (
    SELECT
        b."Location",
        NULLIF(b."Shuttle Run sec", 0) - NULLIF(e."Shuttle Run sec", 0) AS improvement_sec
    FROM
        "sportathon_baseline" b
    JOIN
        "sportathon_endline" e
        ON jaro_winkler_similarity(lower(trim(b."Child ID")), lower(trim(e."Child ID"))) >= 0.9
        AND b."Child ID" = e."Child ID"
        QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b."Child ID" ORDER BY jaro_winkler_similarity(lower(trim(b."Child ID")), lower(trim(e."Child ID"))) DESC) = 1
    WHERE
        b."Location" IN ('Chembur', 'Dharavi', 'Govandi', 'Kurla', 'Mankhurd', 'Wadala')
        AND e."Location" IN ('Chembur', 'Dharavi', 'Govandi', 'Kurla', 'Mankhurd', 'Wadala')
)
SELECT
    "Location",
    AVG(improvement_sec) AS avg_improvement_sec
FROM
    location_improvements
GROUP BY
    "Location"
ORDER BY
    "Location";
```
